author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at Quantum Computing Inc. and Quantinuum

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) has appointed Susan Hunt as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO). Hunt brings over 30 years of experience in enterprise sales and go-to-market execution across AI, cloud computing, and telecommunications, having previously held executive roles at Orbital Insight, Nuance Communications, LivePerson, Salesforce, and Sprint PCS. Concurrently, former CRO Pouya Dianat has transitioned into the newly created role of Chief Product Officer (CPO) to direct QCi’s product strategy and manage the commercialization roadmap across its photonics and semiconductor portfolio. The official release is available here.

Quantinuum has appointed Robin Schulman as Chief Legal Officer (CLO) and Company Secretary, effective July 13, 2026, and Rory O’Byrne as Chief People Officer (CPO), effective May 26, 2026. Both report to President and CEO Dr. Rajeeb Hazra. Schulman previously served as Chief Legal Officer and Head of Corporate Affairs at GitLab, as well as CLO at Couchbase and New Relic. O’Byrne brings over 25 years of human resources experience, most recently serving as Chief People Officer for Advanced Energy. Both appointments support the company’s organizational operations as a publicly listed entity. The complete announcement can be found here.

We wish all these organizations and individuals success in their new endeavors.

July 25, 2026
